prompts.base:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D fighting game sprite atlas. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY character identity reference, IMAGE 2 is ONLY the approved painterly arcade sprite style and pose-layout reference; NEVER copy the bearded man from image 2. Render Gustavo in the exact same illustrated semi-realistic game sprite style as image 2, sharp silhouette, dark clean contour, painted fabric shading, no pixelation or 3D/plastic rendering.
Subject: Prof. Gustavo, the man in photo reference IMAGE 1. Lock his likeness: medium-light warm skin, adult man, high forehead and receding temples, dark brown hair pulled back into a short tied ponytail, brown eyes, elongated oval face, prominent straight nose, thin lips, subtle light facial stubble with a small distinct narrow vertical goatee/soul patch under the lower lip. NO full beard and NO glasses. Medium slender-to-average build, realistic proportions, NOT a huge bodybuilder. Outfit in EVERY pose: plain beige/tan short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt matching his photo, dark blue denim jeans, dark brown/tan lace-up casual shoes. Same face, hair, shirt, trousers and shoes throughout.
Composition: precisely SIXTEEN full-body poses in a FOUR-column by FOUR-row evenly spaced grid. One complete figure in each cell, row-major order. All face RIGHT in a consistent three-quarter side view. All cells contain the same character at the same body scale. Transparent background with actual alpha. Generous transparent margins around every figure, including hands, ponytail and soles. No figures or limbs crossing cell boundaries; no clipping at the image edges. No grid, no labels, no text, no floor shadows, no scenery, no props, no floating particles or glow. Even the horizontal lying pose must fit entirely inside its cell. Standing soles approximately 93% down each cell, pelvis approximately 45% across the cell. Preserve the photo face, not the reference sheet face.
Create the BASE atlas with this EXACT pose map:
ROW 1: 0 neutral standing fighting guard, feet apart, knees slightly bent, both fists raised, full body; 1 subtle alternate guard with same feet; 2 a natural forward walking step; 3 opposite walking step with the other leg leading and one heel lifted.
ROW 2: 4 neutral airborne jump with both knees bent and feet lifted; 5 deep crouch with fists up; 6 standing punch preparation fist drawn back; 7 standing punch fully extended horizontally RIGHT at upper chest height.
ROW 3: 8 standing high-kick preparation with one knee raised; 9 standing high kick, kicking leg fully extended RIGHT at chest height, support shoe on the ground; 10 high standing guard covering face; 11 recoiling from an incoming hit, leaning backward.
ROW 4: 12 power windup standing with hands cupped low at belly, similar to image 2; 13 power release with both hands fully thrust RIGHT at chest height; 14 victorious arms raised; 15 knocked out lying horizontally on back, head LEFT, soles RIGHT, full body wholly within last cell.
Avoid changing clothes or identity, extra fingers, duplicate poses, microscopic poses, missing feet.
